comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Lima requires weekly contributions to maintain its development status -- the church dungeon is only accessible if the three fields of adventure, trade and battle are at 40k+.

If it drops below 40k in one or more fields, then the city regresses and the dungeon becomes unavailable until its next development update cycle (every Monday I think it was) when all three fields are at 40k+. You can still reach the dungeon with ESBT of course... as long as it was your last visited dungeon, or if you use Change Expedition Destination Ticket to set Lima Church as your current dungeon.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Lima Church Dungeon: OPEN

Culture levels as of 3/4, 12am server time:

Adventure - 41,536
Trade - 40,004
Maritime - 40,067

Every Monday, the game will check and update Lima's status automatically. The values only increase if delivery items (listed above) are donated to the City Official or other in-town NPCs.

If all values are 40k or higher, then the city will achieve maximum "colony development" level of Central Capital; special archive maps and the Lima Church dungeon will be available during this time. If not, and you have urgent need to visit the dungeon for some reason (legacy?), then refer to BlakeC's tip above.

Cheers.
